metadata.title: 微观存储介质与制造工艺全景 (2024-2026)
metadata.subtitle: Sub-task A: NAND/DRAM + Emerging Memory + Advanced Packaging
metadata.scope: NAND/DRAM stacking, HBM, DDR5 MRDIMM, LPDDR5T, CXL, MRAM/ReRAM/FeRAM/FeFET/PCM/HBF/HCNRAM, TSV/hybrid bonding, 2.5D/3D advanced packaging, CoWoS capacity
metadata.sourcing_policy: Every datum linked to a verifiable URL. No fabricated numbers. Standard/seminar/IR/EOL items cite original document or official press release.

TSMC investor/tech symposiums, Intel Foveros Direct tech brief

section_1_nand_3d_4d_stacking.summary: 2024-2026 NAND 进入了 200-400 层级竞争。所有厂商均向 hybrid bonding (Cu-Cu, wafer-to-wafer 或 chip-to-wafer) 切换。Samsung V10 (400-layer) 与 YMTC 300+ 进入 HVM,Kioxia BiCS10 332-layer 已 sampling。

products.name: V9 TLC 1Tb (290-layer)
products.tech_node: V9, 290 layers, double-stack, 1.5x bit density vs V8, I/O 3.2 Gb/s

products.name: V9 QLC 1Tb (286-layer)
products.tech_node: QLC, 286 layers, 86% higher bit density than prior QLC, double write perf, 60% faster I/O

products.name: V10 400-layer TLC (triple-stack)
products.tech_node: 400+ layers, triple-stack, 1Tb TLC, vertical bonding, transfers to Pyeongtaek P1

products.name: 321-layer 4D NAND 1Tb TLC (Three Plugs)
products.tech_node: 1Tb TLC, 321 layers, 59% productivity gain vs 238-layer 512Gb; Three Plugs process

products.name: BiCS8 Gen2 218-layer 1Tb TLC/QLC (CBA + OPS)
products.tech_node: 218 layers, CMOS-Bonded-to-Array (CBA), On-Pitch SGD (OPS); 3200 MT/s I/O; 18.3 Gb/mm² density for 1Tb TLC; 50% bit density gain vs BiCS6

products.name: BiCS9 (low-cost 1Tb TLC)
products.announce_date: FMS 2024 concept; mass production at end of fiscal 2025
products.note: Targeted at low-cost / affordable SSD solutions (parallel to BiCS10)

products.name: BiCS10 1Tb TLC 332-layer
products.tech_node: 332 layers, CBA + OPS, Toggle DDR6.0 @ 4,800 MT/s (33% over BiCS8); 29+ Gb/mm² (+59% bit density); 30% read / 18% write power efficiency

products.name: X3-6070 QLC 128-layer (Xtacking 3.0)
products.tech_node: Xtacking 3.0, 1Tb QLC, 2,400 MT/s I/O; ~19.8 Gb/mm² density

products.name: 232-layer QLC (Xtacking 3.0, BSSC, Center X-DEC)
products.tech_node: Xtacking 3.0, 232 layers, 1Tb TLC and QLC; world-first 200+ layer NAND

products.name: Xtacking 4.0 (X4-9060 / X4-9070 / X4-6080)
products.announce_date: 2024 product lineup; 2025 mass production; CFMS 2025 award
products.tech_node: Centered X-DEC, Backside Source Connect (BSSC), 20-hole VC; 155 nm pitch; 160-layer TLC (X4-9060); 232-layer TLC (X4-9070); 232-layer QLC (X4-6080); die size 40.44 mm², 12.66 Gb/mm² for 512 Gb chip

products.name: 276-layer TLC (G9)
products.tech_node: 276 layers, 21 Gbit/mm² TLC density, 3600 MT/s I/O (per AnandTech FMS 2024 reporting)

key_general_sources.name: FMS 2025 program reference (Sandisk HBF Best of Show)

section_2_dram.summary: DRAM 周期进入 HBM/HBM4 (16-Hi 64GB), DDR5 MRDIMM Gen2 (12,800 MT/s) and LPDDR5T (9.6 GT/s) 同时推进。HBM3E 12-Hi 36GB 三家均 2024-Q3 量产出货。HBM4 2025-H2/2026 进入 mass production。

members.name: HBM3E 24GB 8-Hi
members.tech_node: 24GB, 8-Hi, >9.2 Gb/s pin, >1.2 TB/s bandwidth, 30% lower power than competition; ships with NVIDIA H200

members.name: HBM3E 36GB 12-Hi (production-capable)
members.announce_date: 2024-09-05 (blog); 2024-08/Sept shipping to NVIDIA B100/B200, AMD MI325X, etc.
members.tech_node: 36GB, 12-Hi, >9.2 Gb/s pin, >1.2 TB/s bandwidth

members.name: HBM3E 12-Hi 36GB (world's first 12-Hi HBM3E)
members.tech_node: 36GB (12 x 3GB dies, each die 40% thinner); TSV; Advanced MR-MUF process; 10% better heat dissipation; 9.6 Gb/s pin; supplied to customers within 2024

members.name: HBM3E 12H 36GB (Shinjuku / TC NCF)
members.tech_node: 36GB 12-Hi, 1,280 GB/s bandwidth; TC NCF (Thermal Compression Non-Conductive Film) — 7 µm die-to-die spacing; same package height as 8-Hi

members.name: JESD270-4 HBM4 standard
members.tech_node: Up to 8 Gb/s per pin across 2,048-bit interface, up to 2 TB/s total bandwidth; 32 channels (64 pseudo-channels) per stack; 4-high/8-high/12-high/16-high; 24 Gb / 32 Gb die densities; max cube 64 GB (32 Gb 16-Hi); DRFM for row-hammer mitigation; VDDQ 0.7/0.75/0.8/0.9V, VDDC 1.0/1.05V; backward-compatible with HBM3 controllers

members.name: HBM4 mass-production ready (industry first)
members.tech_node: Doubled bandwidth vs HBM3E; >40% better power efficiency; 2,048 I/O (double); >10 Gb/s pin (above 8 Gb/s JEDEC); Advanced MR-MUF + 1bnm (5th gen 10nm) process; 36GB 12-Hi capacity

members.name: HBM4 36GB 12-Hi (2026 ramp) + 48GB 16-Hi samples
members.tech_node: >11.0 Gb/s pin, >2.8 TB/s per stack; 20% better pJ/bit than HBM3E 12-Hi

members.name: HBM4 (development)
members.note: Samsung targeting 48GB HBM4 single-stack; 4nm logic die test yield >40% (TrendForce Apr 2025); production targeted 2025

members.name: JESD79-5 DDR5 SDRAM (C/D revisions)
members.note: JESD79-5C published 2024-04-17 (Per-Row Activation Counting, PRAC); JESD79-5D Nov 2025 v1.41

members.name: MRDIMM Gen1 / Gen2 (DDR5MDB02 / DDR5MRCD02)
members.tech_node: Gen1 8,800 MT/s (Micron/Montage); Gen2 raw cards target 12,800 MT/s (45% boost); Gen3 target 17,600 MT/s

members.name: DDR5 MRDIMM 8800 MT/s (32/64/96/128/256 GB)
members.tech_node: Industry first 8800 MT/s MRDIMM; up to 39% bandwidth gain vs RDIMM; up to 40% lower latency; supports Intel Xeon 6 Granite Rapids

members.name: 256GB DDR5 RDIMM 9200 MT/s (1-gamma)
members.tech_node: 1-gamma DRAM + 3DS TSV; 9,200 MT/s; 40% faster than today's volume RDIMM

members.name: LPDDR5X-9600 (1-beta, 16GB)
members.tech_node: 9.6 GT/s, 76.8 GB/s peak bandwidth; 16GB packages

members.name: LPDDR5T-9600
members.tech_node: 9.6 GT/s (1.01-1.12V VDD); 16GB; 'T' = Turbo

members.name: 1-Gamma LPDDR5X 9600 MT/s
members.tech_node: 1-gamma node, EUV-enabled; 15% speed gain / 20% power reduction vs 1-beta

members.name: CXL 3.0 specification
members.tech_node: PCIe 6.0 PHY; 256 GB/s x16 bidirectional; pooled memory via Fabric Manager; peer-to-peer

members.name: CXL 3.1 specification
members.tech_node: Extended metadata 32-bit, port-based routing (PBR), direct P2P .mem, CXL-TSP trusted execution, improved RAS (DDR5 scrubbing)

members.name: DDR5 pooling via CXL 2.0/3.x Type 3 device
members.note: CXL Type 1 (cache only), Type 2 (cache+device memory, e.g. AI accelerator with HBM), Type 3 (memory expansion, e.g. Samsung CMM-D, Micron CZ120, SK hynix AXDIMM); ~100 ns latency

section_3_emerging_memory.summary: 成熟度差异巨大: MRAM (Samsung/Everspin/Netsol 已量产出货), ReRAM (Weebit 22nm first wafers 2023-11 + Aug 2024 FMS 进展), FeFET (TSMC IEDM 2024 papers, GlobalFoundries 28nm FeFET 量产), PCM/3D XPoint (Intel Optane 已停产), HBF (Sandisk+SK hynix OCP 规范 2026-08, Samsung 加入 2025-10), NRAM (Nantero 已 2024 年关停).

members.name: 1Gb STT-MRAM (EMD4E001G16G2) on GlobalFoundries 28nm
members.tech_node: 1Gb density, DDR4 interface, 0.0396 µm² cell (25% of previous 256Mb), 110 nm WL pitch / 180 nm BL pitch, 9.75 Mb/mm² density; 7 metal BEOL layers

members.name: 28nm FD-SOI eMRAM (mass production since 2019)
members.name_3: 8nm eMRAM (announced Apr 2026 — 62.5% faster write, 11.5% higher density vs 14nm)

members.name: MRAM Design-Technology-System Co-Optimization for AI Edge (IEDM 2024 paper)
Embedded ReRAM on GlobalFoundries 22FDX (first wafers)
members.announce_date: 2023-11-21 first wafers received; 2024-08 (FMS 2024) — first performance data publicly shown (10K cycles at 105°C endurance, retention at 150°C; 8Mb demo chip)
members.tech_node: 22nm FD-SOI (embedded flash not viable at this node)

members.name: ReRAM on DB HiTek 130nm BCD (tape-out announced 2024)
ReRAM 40nm (historical)
members.note: Reference — Crossbar 40nm ReRAM IP widely licensed

members.name: PSoC Edge MCU family with RRAM
members.note: Embedded RRAM on 28nm (per RRAM-Info industry coverage 2024)

members.name: 28nm FeFET research (IEDM 2024 — OS-FeFET 0.009 µm² cell)
members.tech_node: Oxide-semiconductor-channel FeFET (OS-FeFET) — smallest cell area 0.009 µm²; >40 µA/µm read; <30 ns program; >1000s retention at 85°C; 10¹² cycle endurance via HZO phase engineering

members.name: MSP430 FRAM MCU family
members.note: Production since 2010s, PZT-based ferroelectric on CMOS

members.name: Optane (3D XPoint) — DISCONTINUED
members.tech_node: Two-layer stacked cross-point PCM + OTS selector; 128 Gb die at 20nm; consumer 16/32GB; enterprise up to 512GB per module
members.note: Pipeline alive: SK hynix Selector-Only Memory for CXL; Sony/Micron PCM derivatives in research

members.name: HBF (High Bandwidth Flash) — first OCP technical spec
members.tech_node: 8-Hi / 16-Hi NAND stacks; up to 512 GB capacity; 3 performance grades (~0.4 TB/s to 3.0 TB/s); UCIe interconnect; 375-layer 4D NAND substrate; ~2.5× power efficiency improvement

members.name: zNAND-O (HBF class)
members.note: Samsung entered HBF development 2025-Q4; zNAND-O uses TSV + UCIe interface, planned alongside V10 400+ layer BV-NAND

members.name: HBF + CBA — FMS 2025 Best of Show 'Most Innovative Technology'
members.tech_node: 8-16x HBM capacity at similar cost; 1,638 GB/s bandwidth target; 512 GB max; CBA (CMOS directly Bonded to Array) technology

members.name: NRAM — company ceased operations 2024; some equipment auctioned Aug 2024
members.tech_node: Two-terminal CNT fabric cell; CMOS-compatible; theoretical sub-20nm scaling

members.vendor: Fujitsu Semiconductor Memory Solution (Ramxeed from Jan 2025)
members.name: NRAM (joint development with Nantero since 2016)
members.tech_node: 55nm process; planned 2018 product launch — did not reach market

technologies.name: Molecular / atomic storage
technologies.note: Experimental only. No commercially manufactured products identified in 2024-2026.

section_4_manufacturing_processes.summary: 先进封装与混合键合是 AI 内存瓶颈的核心解药。TSV 微凸点从 20→10→5µm 演化; hybrid bonding 从 ~9µm (AMD MI300 V-Cache, Intel Foveros Direct Gen1) 走向 6µm (TSMC SoIC HVM 2026) 与 3µm (Foveros Direct Gen2 / TSMC SoIC-Next 2027)。CoWoS 月产能 2024-13K → 2024-EoY 35K → 2025-EoY 75K → 2026-EoY 100-130K wafers。

data_points.value: 50 µm (Lakefield); ~36 µm (Meteor Lake/Ponte Vecchio via EMIB)

members.name: SoIC (System on Integrated Chips) — SoIC-X (bumpless) and SoIC-P (micro-bump)
members.tech_node: Face-to-face (F2F) and face-to-back (F2B) hybrid Cu-Cu bonding; 6 µm in HVM Feb 2026; SoIC-Next 3 µm target 2027; 4.5 µm target 2029 with A14-to-A14 SoIC; ~14,000 signals/mm² F2F vs ~1,500 F2B

members.name: 3D V-Cache (TSMC SoIC Gen1 — 9 µm pitch)

products.cache_L3: 208 MB (2 x 64 MB V-Cache + 32 MB base per CCD x2)
products.note: AMD first dual 3D V-Cache desktop CPU

products.cache_L3: 1,152 MB per socket (96 MB per CCD)

members.tech_node: >200X interconnect density vs 2D chiplet; >15X vs microbump 3D; 64 MB L3 cache die on 8-core Zen 5 CCD; TSV; direct Cu-Cu bond

members.name: Foveros Direct 3D (Cu-Cu hybrid bonding)
members.tech_node: Sub-10 µm pitch via direct Cu-Cu hybrid bonding; up to 10x interconnect density vs conventional microbump; Gen1 9 µm; Gen2 3 µm; often combined with EMIB as EMIB 3.5D; planned for Intel 18A-PT in H2 2026

members.name: CoWoS-S (silicon interposer), CoWoS-L (RDL + LSI/local silicon interconnect bridges), CoWoS-R (RDL only), CoWoS-X (extension)
members.tech_node: CoWoS-L = RDL interposer with localized silicon bridges (cheaper, larger reticle limit; supports >100×100 mm² packages); CoWoS-X for very large integration

members.name: EMIB 2.5D (Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge)
members.tech_node: Silicon bridge embedded in organic substrate; 36 µm microbumps (Foveros-S/R); Foveros Direct 3D + EMIB = EMIB 3.5D

data.note: Qualified for NVIDIA B-series packaging, OSAT partner

data.pitch: ~30-40 µm (with Samsung TC NCF thinner gaps ~7 µm at HBM3E 12-Hi)
thinned die 40% (SK hynix 12-Hi); Samsung TC NCF 7 µm spacing
Hybrid bonding under exploration (AMD commentary: 17x more energy efficient vs microbump HBM)

narrative_summary.2024: Samsung 主导 9th-gen V-NAND (TLC 290L Q2/Q3 QLC 286L) 和 HBM3E 12-Hi。SK hynix 8-Hi HBM3E 量产出货首例。Micron HBM3E 8-Hi 2024-02 量产出货,12-Hi 2024-09 进入 production-capable。DDR5 MRDIMM 8800 MT/s (Micron 32-256GB) 与 LPDDR5T 9600 (SK hynix/Micron) 同年发布。Intel Optane 已停产。CoWoS 月产能 2024-13K → EoY ~35-40K。HBF 概念出现。
narrative_summary.2025: SK hynix 321-layer NAND 2024-11-21 mass production, 1H25 量产。Samsung V10 400-layer 2024-12 dev 完成,2025 H2 量产。Micron G9 276-layer TLC 2400→3600 MT/s。Kioxia BiCS8 Gen2 218-layer FMS 2024 CBA+OPS。HBM4 JEDEC 规范 2025-04-16 颁布。SK hynix HBM4 2025-09-12 全球首例完成开发、备好 mass production。Samsung HBM4 4nm 逻辑裸片 40%+ test yield。Weebit 22nm ReRAM 性能在 FMS 2024 公开。Samsung 14nm eMRAM 量产目标 2024-EoY, 8nm eMRAM 路线图发布。CoWoS 2025-EoY 75-80K wpm。
narrative_summary.2026: Kioxia BiCS10 332-layer engineering samples 2026-07, mass production Fab2 Kitakami 2026。MRDIMM Gen2 raw card 12,800 MT/s 路线图公布,Gen3 17,600 MT/s 路线图公布。HBM4 12-Hi 36GB + 16-Hi 48GB 各家全面量产。Sandisk+SK hynix HBF OCP 规范 2026-08,512GB/3 TB/s/UCIe。Samsung 加入 HBF(zNAND-O)。CoWoS EoY 2026 100-130K wpm。TSMC SoIC 6µm HVM Feb 2026。Intel Foveros Direct 3µm (Gen2) planned 18A-PT H2 2026。

open_data_points_or_uncertainties: Samsung V10 400+ layer NAND Q3 2025 ISSCC 2025 paper — specific URL not surfaced in this pass; TechInsights/TrendForce have the technology details.
YMTC Xtacking 5.0 / 300+ layer NAND — claimed for 2025-2026 in some Chinese-language press; no verified JEDEC/ISSCC link yet surfaced.
Exact HBF mass-production volume by Samsung — only conceptual design phase confirmed as of 2025-10; mass production not yet confirmed.
Exact CoWoS EoY 2026 figure varies 100K (Nomad Semi), 120-130K (Silicon Analysts), 140-150K (SemiWiki citing TrendForce). All cited.
AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition — cache figure 208 MB per AMD marketing page.
BiCS9 sampling/mass-production date — only roadmap mentioned (end fiscal 2025); no specific product URL surfaced.
